title: Medellín: the city of eternal spring
goal: Talk about Medellín and correct assumptions about it with *no es que… sino que…*, attributing each judgement.
grammar: no es que… sino que…, applied to Medellín

items: I can reject a reason and give the real one with *no es que* + subjunctive and *sino que* + indicative.
I can say why Medellín is called the city of eternal spring and give the dates of the metro and the Metrocable.
I can use the new words for hillside, district, staircase and killing.
